description: Characterize the pore geometry of one controller-approved rigid framework with Zeo++ (one Voronoi decomposition, Zeo++ built-in radii). Returns largest included/free sphere diameters (Angstrom), channel count and dimensionality, accessible and non-accessible surface area (m2/g, m2/cm3), probe-occupiable pore volume (cm3/g, cell fraction), pore size distribution mode/mean, the RASPA pocket-blocking sphere count, an optional independent grid cross-check, caution flags, evidence paths and cost. Geometry only: it does not predict adsorption, and results depend on the fixed probe and radii.
